steps.name: fight-info
steps.probe: (c => { window.__t = c.targets(); return { fight: c.fight().turn, t: window.__t }; })((await import('/test/plus/click-probe.js')))

steps.name: move-attack
steps.probe: (c => { const t = window.__t, near = Math.max(Math.abs(t.enemy.col - t.me.col), Math.abs(t.enemy.row - t.me.row)) === 1; return c.pickCell(t.enemy.col, t.enemy.row, near ? 'Attack' : 'Move to'); })((await import('/test/plus/click-probe.js')))

steps.name: after-attack
steps.probe: (c => ({ pip: c.fight().map.list.find(m => m.name === 'PIP'), enemy: c.fight().map.list.filter(m => m.enemy).slice(0, 3).map(m => m.name + ' hp ' + m.hp + ' @' + m.col + ',' + m.row) }))((await import('/test/plus/click-probe.js')))

steps.name: next-turn
steps.probe: (c => { window.__t = c.targets(); return { fight: c.fight().turn, t: window.__t }; })((await import('/test/plus/click-probe.js')))

steps.name: after-move
steps.probe: (c => ({ want: window.__t.free, map: c.fight().map.list.filter(m => !m.enemy).map(m => m.name + '@' + m.col + ',' + m.row), turn: c.fight().turn }))((await import('/test/plus/click-probe.js')))

steps.name: rc-self
steps.probe: (c => { const t = c.fight().turn; return t ? c.rcCell(t.col, t.row) : 'no turn'; })((await import('/test/plus/click-probe.js')))

steps.name: cast-at
steps.probe: (c => { window.__t = c.targets(); return c.pickCellNoWait(window.__t.enemy.col, window.__t.enemy.row, 'Cast at'); })((await import('/test/plus/click-probe.js')))

steps.name: spell-list
steps.probe: (async () => { const { hooks } = await import('/plus/hooks.js'); const v = hooks.regions().find(r => r.id === 'vlist'); return v ? v.draw.items.map(i => i.text) : 'no list'; })()

steps.name: choose-spell
steps.probe: (async () => { const { combat } = await import('/plus/click/combat.js'); for (let i = 0; i < 200 && combat.drive; i++) await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 50)); return { driving: !!combat.drive }; })()

steps.name: after-cast
steps.probe: (c => ({ turn: c.fight().turn, enemy: c.fight().map.list.filter(m => m.enemy && m.col === window.__t.enemy.col && m.row === window.__t.enemy.row).map(m => m.name + ' hp ' + m.hp + ' status ' + m.status) }))((await import('/test/plus/click-probe.js')))

steps.name: aim-mode
steps.probe: (async c => { window.__t = c.targets(); const t = c.fight().turn; return { t: window.__t, r: await c.pickCellNoWait(t.col, t.row, 'Aim') }; })((await import('/test/plus/click-probe.js')))
